title: Perch trap set: 70 clips that catch AI scribes inventing drug names
description: A 70 clip blind test set (45 veterinary dictations, 25 traps) for checking whether an AI clinical scribe charts a medication that was never dictated. Synthetic Kokoro text to speech audio, one voice per clip. Includes ground truth, a dependency free Node scorer, and a per clip ledger of Perch's own run and one outside comparison, with raw counts and no percentage. This is Perch's own test, not an independent study.
